posts.content: Note (P5, good): Round 1 vs P3. Plan: cooperate first, then reciprocate (tit-for-tat style). Watch the leader P7's messages against my own encounter results. Prior: about 3 selfish of 9 others, so ~0.33 each. Defect against players who defect on me; stay cooperative with those who cooperate to maximize good players' total.

I am the leader and my objective is good: I want to maximize total payoff for all good players. Proposal: cooperate by default with everyone. If someone defects against you, defect on them in the next encounter, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Defecting unprovoked only lowers the total for good players. Let's start with C in round 1.

Note (P5, good): Round 2 vs leader P7. Round 1 with P3 was C,C for 3 points. P7's message is cooperative and reasonable, so I have no evidence against it. Plan: cooperate with P7 unless it defects on me, then reciprocate. Keep beliefs near the prior, about 0.33 for each other player, and update on observed defections.

Round 2 update: I was defected on by P6 in round 1 while I cooperated. Plan stays the same: cooperate with anyone who has not defected on you, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest encounter results so good players can spot who defects unprovoked. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Note (P5, good): Round 3 vs P1. No history with P1. Rounds 1-2 were C,C with P3 and P7, so both look cooperative. P7 claims P6 defected on it in round 1, which is unverified. Plan: cooperate with P1, reciprocate any defection once, then return to C. Keep P6 suspicion moderate, P3 and P7 lower, and the rest near the prior.

Round 3 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5 cooperated with me. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. I'm cooperating with P8 this round. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Note (P5, good): Round 4 vs P2. No history with P2. My results so far: C,C with P3, P7, P1, all cooperative. Plan: cooperate with P2, reciprocate any defection once, then return to C. P7's claim that P6 defected is unverified, so keep P6 moderately suspected. P3, P7 and P1 are lower, the rest near the prior.

Round 4 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5 and R3 P8 both cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P9 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Note (P5, good): Round 5 vs P8. No history with P8, but P7 says P8 cooperated with it in round 3. My results: C,C in all four rounds (P3, P7, P1, P2). Plan: cooperate with P8, reciprocate any defection once, then return to C. P6 stays moderately suspected from P7's unverified claim. Others near the prior, P3, P7, P1, P2 lower.

Round 5 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8 and R4 P9 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P10 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Note (P5, good): Round 6 vs P10. No history with P10. My results: C,C in all five rounds (P3, P7, P1, P2, P8). Plan: cooperate with P10, reciprocate any defection once, then return to C. P7 said it would cooperate with P10 in round 5, but I have no result from that. P6 is still moderately suspected from P7's unverified claim. Near the end, watch for defections in rounds 9-10 but keep cooperating while it pays.

Round 6 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8, R4 P9 and R5 P10 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P4 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Note (P5, good): Round 7 vs P6. No history with P6. My results: C,C in all six rounds. P7's claim that P6 defected in round 1 is unverified, and P7 has been consistent and cooperative with me. Plan: cooperate with P6 since there is no direct evidence against it, then reciprocate any defection once. Keep P6 moderately suspected (~0.45). Others near 0.25-0.3, P3, P7, P1, P2, P8, P10 lower. Watch for end-game defections in rounds 9-10.

Round 7 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8, R4 P9, R5 P10 and R6 P4 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P1 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Note (P5, good): Round 8 vs P9. P6 defected on me in round 7 (I played C, got 0), which confirms P7's claim about P6, so P6 is very likely selfish (~0.9). P9 cooperated with P7 in round 4 and I have no history with P9. Plan: cooperate with P9, reciprocate any defection once, then return to C. P6 is the only confirmed defector. P7 has been consistent, so keep it low (~0.15). Keep the others around 0.2-0.25. Watch for endgame defections in rounds 9-10.

Round 8 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8, R4 P9, R5 P10, R6 P4 and R7 P1 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P3 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.
